scope: 15 explicit finite inputs, 30 exact sample averages, and direct local-block checks in n=2..6; geometry covers omitted indices

finite_input.definition: E_N=(R^n minus T Z^n axis-cube pores) intersect T[-N,N]^n

witnesses.name: centre
witnesses.mass_method: exact Laurent coefficient recurrence; balanced-index formula cross-check; full local integer block independently summed

witnesses.name: near_corner
witnesses.mass_method: 25 exact interval-intersection products; other balanced indices have a zero factor; full local integer block independently summed
